Previous 35 browser results retained through matching public markup and shared assets. All 55 originality records recalculated against 873 routes and original pre-editorial templates; closest meanings reviewed without inventing exclusive local fault topics.

No new performance measurements or launch-target pass. Raw/Brotli-quality-5/gzip-9 export totals and per-route ranges describe emitted representations, not observed per-visit transfers or timing.
Historical geography and planning context do not prove local demand, defects, jobs, serviceability or specialist authority. All business and indexation holds remain.
